9
A footballer kicks a stationary football.
His foot is in contact with the ball for 0.050s.
The mass of the ball is 0.40kg.
The speed of projection of the ball is 25m/s.
What is the average force exerted on the ball by his foot?
A
0.32N
B
0.50N
C
200N
D
1300N
subject: Physics
